title: Standard Chartered Obtains IFSCA Nod for GIFT City Wealth Management Services
summary: Expands offshore wealth distribution capabilities from India's International Financial Services Centre.

blocks.content: Expands offshore wealth distribution capabilities from India's International Financial Services Centre.

items: Standard Chartered received IFSCA approval to offer wealth management services out of its GIFT City IBU branch.
First foreign bank to establish an onshore wealth management unit in GIFT City.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Standard Chartered was the first foreign bank to commence operations in GIFT City (2020).
